merger_description:
Seidler Equity, through a newly incorporated vehicle, Rockstars BidCo 1 Pty Ltd, proposes to acquire the total issued share capital in Eco Outdoor Australia Pty Ltd (**Eco Outdoor**) (the **Acquisition**).

Seidler Equity is a private investment firm specialising in providing long-term equity capital to family-owned businesses across Australia with a presence in the United States. Within Australia, Seidler Equity holds interests in various other industries, including consumer products, professional services, and business services.

Eco Outdoor is an Australian retailer and distributor of high-end outdoor architectural products, including natural stone and porcelain pavers, tiles, cladding, decking and flooring materials and pool surface materials. It also supplies outdoor furniture, accessories and fabrics. The company operates in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and Adelaide, and supplies residential and commercial customers, as well as architects, designers, and landscape professionals. Eco Outdoor sources its products both domestically and internationally.

Following the Acquisition, Eco Outdoor will be indirectly owned in the following proportions: (i) 45% by entities managed or advised by Seidler Equity and (ii) 55% by the vendors, being Kerr Stumbles Pty Ltd (as trustee for Kerr Stumbles Family Trust), Killara Pty Ltd (as trustee for Lane Settlement) and Killara Pty Ltd (as trustee for Richard Eckersley Trust).

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition. In particular, there is no horizontal overlap
or vertical relationship between Seidler Equity (including its
controlled portfolio companies) and Eco Furniture in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
